baseName.value: Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF
Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF

generalComment.value: Amorim Wise Cork Pure Polyurethane Prefinished (hereby referred to as Cork Pure PU PF) has a natural cork structure, that provides superior comfort and environmental performance for residential areas, with a genuine cork veneer decorative layer and polyurethane finishing. This product is used as a floor covering for domestic use, providing several physical characteristics to the floor, such as stability, comfort, thermal and noise insulation, among others.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
The manufacturing process of Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF begins with cork granulate production, using cork that was previously treated at Amorim Florestal. Around 88% of the granulated cork previously produced is forwarded to an agglomeration process in which a melamine-urea-formaldehyde (MUF) resin is used to produce the agglomerated cork layer. This layer is the inferior layer of the final product and constitutes most of the thickness of the product. The remaining granulated cork, together with a polyvinyl acetate (PVA) resin, is used to produce the genuine cork veener, the decorative layer of the Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF. The agglomerated cork layer and the decorative genuine cork veener, that compose the final product structure are glued together using glue and adhesives as binding agents. This unfinished product then follows to a pressure and heat process, before going through sanding. The product is ultimately varnished with a base coat as well as a top coat varnish finishing of Polyurethane and forwarded for the final cut of the pieces. The top coat varnishing finalize the product in this stage of the Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF product, which is then packed and stored in the shipment warehouse, ready for shipment.

Declared unit: 
The declared unit is 1 m2 of installed floor covering with the following characteristics:

Der Herstellungsprozess von Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF beginnt mit der Herstellung von Korkgranulat, wobei Kork verwendet wird, der zuvor bei Amorim Florestal behandelt wurde.

Rund 88 % des zuvor hergestellten Korkgranulats werden einem Agglomerationsprozess zugeführt, bei dem ein Melamin-Harnstoff-Formaldehyd-Harz (MUF) zur Herstellung der Agglomeratkorkschicht verwendet wird. Diese Schicht ist die untere Schicht des Endprodukts und macht den größten Teil der Dicke des Produkts aus. Das verbleibende Korkgranulat wird zusammen mit einem Polyvinylacetat (PVA)-Harz zur Herstellung des echten Korkfurniers, der dekorativen Schicht des Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF, verwendet.

Die agglomerierte Korkschicht und das dekorative echte Korkfurnier, die die endgültige Produktstruktur bilden, werden unter Verwendung von Leim und Klebstoffen als Bindemittel miteinander verklebt. Dieses Rohprodukt wird dann einem Druck- und Wärmeprozess unterzogen, bevor es geschliffen wird.

Das Produkt wird schließlich mit einem Basislack sowie einer Decklackierung aus Polyurethan lackiert und zum endgültigen Zuschnitt der Stücke weitergeleitet. Die Decklackierung stellt das Produkt in dieser Phase des Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF-Produkts fertig, das dann verpackt und versandfertig im Versandlager gelagert wird.

technologicalApplicability.value: Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF fits the most demanding needs for domestic areas. This flooring product meets the requirements of the usage class 23 for domestic use according to ISO 10874 standard.

Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF erfüllt die anspruchsvollsten Anforderungen im Wohnbereich. Dieses Bodenbelagsprodukt erfüllt die Anforderungen der Nutzungsklasse 23 für den Hausgebrauch gemäß der Norm ISO 10874.

useAdviceForDataSet.value:
Scope: 
The data on which the Life Cycle Assessment is based is from the manufacturing process of Amorim Wise Cork Pure PU PF taking place in one industrial unit of Amorim Revestimentos (Oleiros) and is referred to the year of 2020. For the construction, use, end of life stages and benefits and loads, data were estimated based on background research and Amorim Cork Flooring supply chain downstream activities. Data associated with the product’s maintenance was obtained through benchmark research. 
System boundary: 
Type of EPD: cradle to gate with options 


Modules A1-A3 Production:  Include processes that provide materials, transport of the material to the manufacturing site, energy supply, product manufacturing and transport processes up to the factory gate, as well as waste processing. Biogenic carbon contained in the product and the packaging materials is included in this module. 


Module A4 Transport: Transport of the floor covering from the factory gate to the place of installation. 


Module A5 Installation: Includes material losses (offcuts) during the installation of the floor covering, use of adhesives and disposal of offcuts and recycling of packaging material. 


Module B2 Maintenance: includes provision of energy, for vacuum cleaning once a week, cleaning agent and water consumption, for wet cleaning twice a year. 

The LCA results in this EPD are declared for a one-year usage. 


Module C1 De-construction: The floor covering is de-constructed manually and no additional environmental impact is caused. 


Module C2 Transport: Includes transportation of the postconsumer waste to the waste incineration plant or to a landfill 


Module C3 Waste processing and Module C4 Disposal, end-of-life scenarios are declared for: 

·         40 % incineration in a waste incineration plant (WIP) and 60 % landfilling (Mixed scenario) 

·         100 % incineration in a waste incineration plant (WIP) (Scenario 1) 

·         100 % landfilling (Scenario 2) 

Module D Benefits and Loads: Declares potential benefits from all net flows given in module A5 (packaging material recycling) and C3 (for incineration, and related energy substitution) that leave the product boundary system after having passed the end-of-waste state. Module D is declared for each scenario separately.
